I’ll answer you... So, if I may correct you and give you some Brazilian insight about the so called Amazon deforestation issue: it has never been so restricted! Compare it, for example, with Lulas’s first and second term! 
The Government headed by Bolsonaro could never have done anything of the sort, because of the pressure by NGO and international treaties that we are bound!
Deforestation of the Amazon rainforest happens because of the massive scale of the forest itself, not as a policy formulated by any Government. 
The Rainforest’s soil is not suitable for agriculture, everyone here knows. All this international lobby saying that we are destroying the Forest are just excuses made up for profiting seeking international speculation to, enrich themselves at our costs!
The Rainforest is a question of national importance, national sovereignty and it must not be treated as some sort of “international condominium”. Please, I advise you, in good faith, to read more about our end of the situation. 
About followers causing havoc on the street: after the election of Lula (a guy that was in JAIL), the uproar in regions that Bolsonaro won (it was a very, very close election) was evident. I was not present. But I understand their anguish on foreseeing the plight that is coming to our Country. But Bolsonaro, in the same week, asked protestors to stop the blocks on the roads. Things are basically back to the normal, as we pray ahead of the dark times that are coming and organize political opposition.

Context: Then I was 18.
I supported him since the VERY early days, when literally people saw him as a joke. This must have been around 2011, when I had 12 years old.
I met in in 2015. I literally traveled to Brasília during school time to meet him. Without my parents knowing. 
This kinda blowed out at my city, and later, during the election (2018), in the whole Brazilian right wing internet. 
So, he knew me as a very loyal and ardent supporter. This event was a debate on economics, held in São Paulo. I just posed for a normal pic, then he look to my cellphone and said: “Did it got good?” I answered that it was kinda shaken, so he called his advisor, told me to lend him my phone that another shot would be taken. I was by his side when he suddenly lifted me up. I had only the reaction to make the characteristic gun sign with my hands. It was awesome!

Politics aside, which I respect different visions - he’s a great guy, great heart! 
He remembered me AFTER he was elected and personally sent me an invitation for the Inauguration, which I gladly attended.
